تنتجبي (form VIII)
# تَنْتَجِبِي (tantajibī) /tan.ta.d͡ʒi.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
# تُنْتَجَبِي (tuntajabī) /tun.ta.d͡ʒa.biː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَجَبَ (intajaba)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
